这部手机还没有密钥：先配对。: This phone has no key yet: pair it first.
这个浏览器不能保存遥控密钥（需要 https 网址）。: This browser cannot keep a remote-control key (it needs an https address).
这个账号还没有开启「从手机遥控」的电脑。: No computer on this account has “Control from phone” turned on.
在电脑上打开 Crossline 的「这台电脑」页，开启算力节点，把「在这台电脑: On the computer, open Crossline’s “This computer” page, turn on the compute node, and set “Run commands on this computer” to “Only from my phone”.
电脑不在线：开始会话、读文件夹、提交表单都要等它连上。其余功能在网页版照常可用。: The computer is offline: starting a session, reading folders and submitting forms wait until it connects. Everything else works on the web as usual.
离线时不会排队执行：签好的指令五分钟后就过期。: Nothing is queued while it is offline: a signed instruction expires after five minutes.
电脑上线时通知我: Notify me when the computer is online
助手要改这些文件: The assistant wants to change these files
助手要执行这条命令: The assistant wants to run this command

对助手说……；以 ! 开头直接执行一条命令: Tell the assistant…; start with ! to run a command directly
在电脑上「这台电脑」页点「添加手机」，把显示的 8 位配对码填在这里: On the computer’s “This computer” page, press “Add phone” and enter the 8-digit pairing code shown there
在电脑上核对这串数字，一致才点「确认」：: Compare these digits on the computer, and press “Confirm” only if they match:
确认后这部手机才能遥控。清除浏览器的网站数据会丢失密钥，要重新配对。: This phone can control the computer only after that confirmation. Clearing the browser’s site data loses the key, and the phone must be paired again.
助手用电脑上本人自己的 ChatGPT 登录运行: The assistant runs on the computer with the person’s own ChatGPT sign-in
会话文件夹内的命令自动执行，其余问我: Run commands inside the session folder automatically, ask me for the rest
五分钟没有回答，已拒绝: No answer in five minutes; refused
已存进 Crossline，几分钟内出现在资料里。: Saved to Crossline; it appears in materials within a few minutes.
列清单不签名；读内容、存进 Crossline、下载原文件都由这部手机签名: Listing needs no signature; reading, saving to Crossline and downloading the original are each signed by this phone
已在电脑上点了「{{button}}」。确认页出现后，报名记录会更新。: Pressed “{{button}}” on the computer. The registration record updates once the confirmation page appears.
只有免费的可以从手机提交；需要付款的永远在电脑前由本人完成: Only free ones can be submitted from the phone; anything that costs money is always finished by the person at the computer
需要付款，只能在电脑上提交: Needs payment; submit it on the computer
截图两分钟内有效；截图后页面有变化，电脑会拒绝。: The screenshot is valid for two minutes; if the page changes after it, the computer refuses.
最近 90 天的遥控记录；电脑上另有一份只追加的审计日志: Remote-control record of the last 90 days; the computer keeps its own append-only audit log
电脑开着时，从手机在这台电脑上工作；每件事都由这部手机签名，电脑自己核对。: While the computer is on, work on it from the phone; everything is signed by this phone and checked by the computer itself.
「只从手机遥控」：只有本人在已配对的手机上签名的会话能执行命令。「无人值守」：网: “Only from my phone”: only sessions the person signs on a paired phone can run commands. “Unattended”: the web assistant can also run commands in the node’s own task folder (editing, transcoding, scripts, grown workflows), each checked by the same rules first. The last step of sending, registering and paying stays with the person
手机只能执行它签了名的指令；手机、文件夹和开关只在这台电脑上设置，网页版改不了: A phone can only run instructions it signed; phones, folders and switches are set only on this computer, and the web cannot change them
移除后，那部手机签的指令一律拒绝: Once removed, every instruction that phone signs is refused
